activity.role: Chu anti-Qin military commander at Julu
activity.notes: Xiang Yu led the revived Chu anti-Qin army at the Battle of Julu in 207 BCE, defeating major Qin forces and becoming predominant among rebel commanders. In 207 BCE the restored Chu royal authority of King Huai II, not Western Chu (established by Xiang Yu in 206 BCE), was the contemporaneous political affiliation. This military Activity is distinct from existing Western Chu hegemon-king reign 206–202 BCE. Later legends about individual prowess and casualty figures are not treated as independently verified facts.
